title: Locational School
html:
Quest Giver: Colonel Cabo

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Go to the Limitless Lower Locationals off Level 5 of MutantMania. Lash out against Grapplin' Gertie and then report back to Colonel Cabo in the MutantMania Training Center.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Colonel Cabo

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: Meet Herschel the Hitter

Zone: Mutant Mania

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Go to the Limitless Lower Locationals off Level 5 of MutantMania. Lash out against Grapplin' Gertie and then report back to Colonel Cabo in the MutantMania Training Center.

Offer:

Your protege Grapplin' Gertie has been pulling in great crowds. Almost as great as yours. Crowds, that is. You both... Ah say, you both fight so well, Ah've been able to do the impossible. Ah've booked you *both* in the Limitless Lower Locationals! You and Gertie will be fighting against each other in the Lower MutantMania regional championships. Get up there and put on a good show! Ah'll be here looking through a safe catalogue...Ah'll need some place to keep all that new money!

Turn-in:

Great job winning the Limitless Lower Locationals, friend. Too great, Ah think. You trounced Grapplin' Gertie so soundly, she says she's never going to fight again. Ever. Losing...I say, losing my second best fighter is going to cost me. But, Ah'm not one to hold a grudge. Even though it's your fault.

Objectives:

  • Lash Out Against Grapplin' Gertie

Level range: 84–100
